title: Calculate Money in Leetcode Bank
summary: Hercy initiates a savings plan by depositing $1 on the first Monday.
statement: Hercy initiates a savings plan by depositing $1 on the first Monday. Each subsequent day from Tuesday to Sunday, he deposits $1 more than the previous day. On each new Monday, he deposits $1 more than the previous Monday's total. Calculate the total deposit after n days.
constraints: Save for n consecutive days, starting with $1 on Monday.
Each next weekday adds $1, while each new Monday starts $1 above the previous Monday.
hints: Whole weeks are arithmetic sequences, as are the remaining weekday deposits.
Split n into complete weeks and a remainder.
Sum 28 per base week plus the increasing Monday offsets, then add the partial week starting at weeks+1.
The formula partitions every deposit by week and weekday exactly once.
editorial: The formula partitions every deposit by week and weekday exactly once.

tests.explanation: The first four deposits are 1, 2, 3, and 4, totaling 10.
A full first week contributes 28 and the next Monday through Wednesday contribute 2+3+4, totaling 37.
